description: Find the ISWC work code(s) behind a recording, by ISRC or SonoVault track ID. Useful for royalty and publishing workflows. By ISRC it returns the works linked to that exact ISRC (basis "isrc"), falling back to every work on the recording (basis "recording") when none is. One recording can carry several ISWCs (medleys, samples, a song registered under more than one ISWC).
name: get_work_codes
title: Recording to composition (ISWC)
